The '''Attack on the ''Jynni's Virtue''''' was an event that occurred in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], exactly six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], ''Jynni's Virtue'', commanded by [[Naz Felyood]] crashed on Korriban after being attacked by [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol ships. While exploring a [[Dathka Graush's tomb|tomb]] on Korriban, Felyood was possessed by the spirit of the deceased [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]]. After Graush possessed Felyood, he unleashed his army of [[Korriban zombie]]s, which attacked the ''Jynni's Virtue''.

The battle was brought to a close when the first mate of the ''Jynni's Virtue'' destroyed the ship and killed the remaining crew and many of the [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]]. However, Naz Felyood was left alive and stranded on the planet.
